 Women's Soccer St. Louis-Bound, Men's Soccer Traveling to Cleveland for NCAA Championships

 The Hope College's men's and women's soccer teams, both MIAA Tournament champions, are hitting the road for the 2026 NCAA Division III Championships. The NCAA announced the 64-team fields on Monday. 
 The Hope women, also the MIAA regular-season co-champs, are traveling to St. Louis, Missouri, while the Hope men are headed to Cleveland, Ohio, for first-round games on Friday, Nov. 13, and second-round games, if advancing, on Saturday, Nov. 14. 
 First-round game times are set for the four-team women's pod hosted by top-ranked Washington University in St. Louis. 
 The Flying Dutch (13-3-2) will meet Simpson College (11-5-1), the American River Conference tournament champs, in the first round. The winner will play either WashU (15-1-2) from the UAA or Belhaven College (7-4-5), the Collegiate Conference of The South champion, in the second round. 
 Ticket prices at WashU are $15 for adults and $5 for seniors, students, and children ages 3-12. Children 2 and under are free. Tickets can be purchased at the gate with a credit card or debit card only. There will be no cash sales and no advance sales. 
 First-round game times are set for the four-team men's pod hosted by Case Western Reserve University.  
 The Flying Dutch will face Transylvania University, the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conferene regular-season and tournament champions, on Friday at 2:30 pm. They will follow the noon game between third-ranked Case Western Reserve, the University Athletic Association champs, and Penn State Behrend, the Allegheny Mountain Conference tournament champions. 
Tickets will be sold at CWRU before Friday's games. There will be no pre-sale. Tickets are $15 for the general public and $5 for college students with an ID. Only credit card purchases will be permitted. There will be no cash sales.
 Both women's and men's games will be streamed for free on NCAA Champ Pass.
